# Turn a Stripe payout report into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free Stripe payout reconciliation to journal converter: proves the rows add up to the payout, splits gross sales, Stripe fees, refunds and disputes by month, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
